2609.24417.title: ARM: Attention with Routed-Memory for Learnable Sparse Control
2609.24417.paper_summary: Despite advances in long-context inference, large language models (LLMs) remain fundamentally limited by the key-value (KV) caching mechanisms that are necessary for stable computation. Techniques such as selective token eviction and pruning have vastly mitigated these issues, but often discard core information to manage the growing cache. In this paper, we propose Attention with Routed Memory (ARM) a novel KV caching structure that introduces a fully differentiable, fixed-size memory system organized as a hierarchical router. Via a Gumbel-Softmax, ARM learns to select memory slots and perform sigmoid-gated updates that softly combine new and stored information, avoiding hard eviction and reducing information loss. By further training a policy to dynamically select varying amounts of memory at inference, ARM adapts its accesses for both simple contexts and inputs that require deeper reasoning, enabling more scalable and effective retrieval on both short- and long-contexts. Experimental results on standard commonsense and long-context reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that ARM achieves superior performance and efficiency compared to fixed KV-caching approaches, while remaining efficient and scalable in terms of both memory and generation latency.
2609.24417.paper_summary_zh: 儘管在長上下文推理方面取得了進展，大型語言模型（LLMs）仍然受到穩定計算所需的鍵值（KV）快取機制的根本限制。<lb/> 像選擇性標記驅逐和修剪等技術在很大程度上緩解了這些問題，但通常會捨棄核心信息以管理不斷增長的快取。<lb/> 在本文中，我們提出了帶有路由記憶的注意力（ARM），這是一種新穎的KV快取結構，介紹了一個完全可微分的固定大小記憶系統，組織為層次路由器。<lb/> 通過Gumbel-Softmax，ARM學會選擇記憶槽並執行sigmoid閘控更新，這些更新柔和地結合了新信息和存儲的信息，避免了硬性驅逐並減少了信息損失。<lb/> 通過進一步訓練一個策略來動態選擇推理時的不同數量的記憶，ARM使其訪問適應於簡單上下文和需要更深入推理的輸入，從而在短上下文和長上下文中實現更具可擴展性和有效的檢索。<lb/> 在標準常識和長上下文推理基準上的實驗結果表明，ARM在性能和效率上優於固定KV快取方法，同時在記憶和生成延遲方面保持高效和可擴展。
